_about: Published per-model credit rates, read from the Higgsfield pricing page's plan-comparison table. THIS IS NOT AVAILABLE THROUGH THE API — models_explore returns capabilities and no price — so it is transcribed here with a date, and it decays. Rates are credits per the stated unit duration and appear to be plan-independent; the $/credit is what varies by plan.
_authority: UI PREFLIGHT WINS. Three sources disagree and they are not equally good: (1) the Generate button in the app is what you will actually be charged, on YOUR plan, for THAT exact configuration — this is authoritative; (2) your transaction ledger is what you WERE charged — authoritative for history and for models absent from the card; (3) the published pricing page is list pricing and was measured wrong twice (see _card_vs_ui) — treat it as indicative only.
_gap: Models absent from the published pricing card are known only from transaction actuals. Treat any model missing from this card as measured-only.

call_contract._source: [PRIMARY · Higgsfield models_explore list/get · 2026-09-19] for roles, modes, resolutions and audio params · [PRIMARY · measured on a production job, 2026-09-19; the close-out note of that date is in the studio's history] for what start_image actually DOES
call_contract._why: One contract per roster VIDEO model, read by prompt_lint.call_shape() — which is the ONE place that decides how a clip call is built. gate.py checks against it and preflight emits it, so the two cannot disagree. Until 2026-09-19 the skill used a role vocabulary copied from an older MiniMax panel (image / character / reference / start_frame / element / video / motion / audio / voice) that NO roster model declares; start frames worked only because the server coerces a lone `image`, and an end frame could not be expressed at all.

_fields.roles: the ONLY medias[].role names the model takes
_fields.frames: does start_image act as a TRUE first frame? true / false / null = not yet measured here
_fields.mix: may start_image/end_image share a call with *_references? null = unmeasured, and is TREATED AS FALSE — a 422 costs a round trip, a wrong guess costs a take
_fields.modes: the model's own `mode` values. Never a shared list: Kling's `mode` is a quality tier, Seedance's and Gemini's are generation modes
_fields.mode_frames / mode_refs: the mode to send when the call binds frames / only references
_fields.resolutions: the model's resolution options as the API spells them (MiniMax is '2K', not '2k')
_fields.audio: param = the switch that silences it (null = there is none); off = the value; default_on
_fields.ref_limits: per-call reference caps {image, video, audio} and, where stated, combined seconds. Absent = prompt_lint's house caps (9 / 3 / 3, MiniMax H3's panel). Over a cap is a WARN naming the model
_fields.prompt_max_chars: the model's TRUE prompt ceiling in characters (Python len, code points) — prompt_lint FAILS above it and WARNS above the house 2,500 where the ceiling is higher. An object {english, non_english} is Kling 4.0's mixed rule: E/english + N/non_english must stay <= 1 (E = ASCII characters, an assumption). `house_ceiling: true` marks a house figure standing in for an unknown vendor cap (v2.45, 2026-10-29)
_fields.negative: `field` = the vendor takes a negative prompt (cap in negative_max_chars, null = unstated → the house 500); `none` = no negative field: a [SUPPRESS] list is DROPPED, never sent (the lint warns, the gate refuses a negative_prompt); `unknown` = not documented → the house 500
_fields.limit_source: where the ceiling was read: url, read date, confidence (confirmed · reseller schema · Higgsfield · secondary · unknown)
_fields.shot_max_chars / max_shots: Kling's multi-shot limits: each stage of a `form: multishot` prompt ≤ shot_max_chars, at most max_shots stages

genjutsu._about: Higgsfield Genjutsu: motion transfer (copy a driving video's motion, gestures, timing and camera path onto the subjects of reference images) and object swap (replace an object, product, garment or character in a source video from reference images). On the approved roster since 2026-11-03 (the author: "Include Genjutsu"), through its own lane: prompt_lint.py `kind: genjutsu`, gate.py `approve genjutsu:<SHOT>`, `gate.py preflight <SHOT> --kind genjutsu`.
genjutsu._source: [PRIMARY · Higgsfield models_explore list/get · 2026-11-03] ids, names, roles, resolutions; [VENDOR · generate_video tool description · 2026-11-03] images with role `image` and exactly one source/driving video with role `video`; `use_free_gens` (backend validates eligibility; a rejected free request is reported, never replaced with a charge)
genjutsu._params_note: models_explore lists `resolution` as the ONLY parameter and no aspect ratios, durations or modes: the output follows the source video. The gate refuses any other generation param on a Genjutsu call. Whether it reads a `prompt` is not documented: a spec without a [PROMPT] block sends none.
genjutsu._durations: 4–30 s source [VENDOR · higgsfield.ai Genjutsu page, read 2026-10-23]; Lite motion transfer up to 15 s [PRIMARY · models_explore 2026-11-03, "Wan 3.0, up to 15 seconds"]. Lite object swap states no limit: the page's 30 s is assumed.
genjutsu.free_gens: [stated · 2026-11-03] Lite has 10 free generations, full has 1. These are the owner's counts on that date, not a live balance: whether they are per model or shared between motion and swap was not stated, and nothing here reads the remaining number. Plan Lite first while its free generations last; send `use_free_gens: true` only when the spec says `free_gens: prefer`.
genjutsu._free_gens_mcp: ⚠️ free_and_unlimited.mcp_caveat (pricing page, 2026-08-29) says free generations are NOT accessible on MCP. The generate_video tool now documents `use_free_gens` with eligibility checked by the backend (2026-11-03). Unverified for Genjutsu on this account: the first free call is the measurement. A rejected free request goes back to the owner; it is never resent on credits without an OK.
